regulation_name: Amendment to Emergency Release Notification Regulations on Reporting Exemption for Air Emissions From Animal Waste at Farms; Emergency Planning and Community Right-to-Know Act

requirements.regulation_section: CERCLA section 103 (cited in Preamble Section I.D)
requirements.requirement_text: Section 103 of CERCLA requires the person in charge of a vessel or facility to immediately notify the National Response Center (NRC) when there is a release of a hazardous substance, as defined under CERCLA section 101(14), in an amount equal to or greater than the reportable quantity for that substance within a 24-hour period.
requirements.plain_language_summary: If your farm has a release of a hazardous substance (such as a manure lagoon spill into water) that meets or exceeds the reportable quantity within a 24-hour period, you must immediately notify the National Response Center. Note that air emissions from animal waste are exempt from this requirement.
requirements.deadline: Immediately upon a release meeting or exceeding the reportable quantity within a 24-hour period

requirements.regulation_section: EPCRA section 304 (cited in Preamble Section I.D and IV)
requirements.requirement_text: EPCRA section 304 requires owners or operators of certain facilities to immediately notify state and local authorities when there is a release of an extremely hazardous substance (EHS), as defined under EPCRA section 302, or of a CERCLA hazardous substance in an amount equal to or greater than the reportable quantity for that substance within a 24-hour period... For example, a release from animal waste into water (e.g., a lagoon breach) or a release from an anhydrous ammonia storage tank into the air might trigger reporting requirements if the release exceeds the applicable reportable quantities.
requirements.plain_language_summary: If your farm has a release of a hazardous substance into water (like a lagoon breach) or a non-waste release into the air (like an ammonia tank leak) that meets or exceeds the reportable quantity within a 24-hour period, you must immediately notify state and local authorities. Air emissions directly from animal waste are exempt.
requirements.deadline: Immediately upon a release meeting or exceeding the reportable quantity within a 24-hour period

recommended_actions: Develop and maintain a spill response plan detailing contact information for the National Response Center and local authorities.
Ensure staff at the 3452-head facility are trained to recognize and immediately report lagoon breaches or non-waste hazardous spills (e.g., ammonia).
summary: Waters Farm 1-5 M&M Rivenbark is currently compliant with CERCLA and EPCRA reporting requirements, as there are no active hazardous substance releases reported for this 3452-head swine facility. The facility must remain prepared to immediately notify the National Response Center and local authorities if a lagoon breach or other reportable spill occurs.
